book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu alengakeka na Shetani
Bhela, Roho waka Chapanga akundongwi Yesu mbaka kulipololu nahuli akalengakikaje na Shetani.
Paajomwi kukonga kula chilebhe kwa machobha alobaini muhi na ikilu, Yesu akaweni injala.
Bhela, Shetani akahikiki na kumpwaghila, “Ngati wehapa nde wa Mwana waka Chapanga, laghalakya maganga aghagha ghakubha mabumunda.”
Nambu Yesu akayangiki, “ ‘Ilembakiki, anana mu Malembu Mahuhu, Mundu ngacheaweza kutama kwa libumunda pena, nambu kwa kila lilobhi leapwagha Chapanga.’ ”
Kabhete Shetani akundongwi Yesu mbaka ku Yelusalemu, Muchi Uhuhu, na kumbeka kunani nakanopi ja Nyumba jaka Chapanga, na kumpwaghila,
“Ngati wehapa nde Mwana waka Chapanga, ulihabhuha pahi, maghambu ilembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: ‘Chapanga anaabhatuma bhatumika bhaki bha kunani kumahunde kwa ndandi jaku,

content: Yesu akamuyangiki, “Nambu Malembu Mahuhu ghapwagha, ‘Ngawandenga Bambo Chapanga waku.’ ”
Panihapa Shetani akuntoliki kabhete Yesu mbaka kunani ja chitombi chilachu nakanopi, na kundangiha ukolongwa wokapi wa pundema na unyahi waki wokapi.
Shetani akumpwaghile, “Ananukupekya hindu hayeyi yokapi, ngati anaunjikamili na kunyojabhela.”
Nambu Yesu akamuyangiki, “Ubhoka pani wa Shetani! Ilembakiki mu Malembu Mahuhu, ‘Unjojabya Bambo Chapanga waku, na untumakya jombi kanjika jaki.’ ”
Bhela Shetani akundekiki Yesu, na bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga bhakahikiki na kuntumakila.
Yesu atumbula kutangaza ku Galilaya
Bhela, Yesu paakajowini kubha Yohana ajeghaliki muchifungo, akapiti ku Galilaya.
Akabhokiki ku Nazaleti, na kujenda kutama ku Kapelenaumu, muchi ghoubhi munkeghi ja bahali ja Galilaya, mu malindakanilu gha wilaya ja Zabuloni na Nafutali.
Haleli lakahengakiki nahuli lipitalyaye lilobhi lela lelapwaghakiki na mlota Isaya,

content.text: “Inchi ja Zabuloni na inchi ja Nafutali,
kujenda kwindela ja bahali kwihi ja nkoka Yoludani,
Galilaya inchi ja bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude!
Na bhombi bhabhatama mu inchi ja lwihi na nhwili wa kupotela,

content: Kutumbu chikahi chenihechi Yesu akatumbwili kutangaza ubholu waki, akapwagha, “Mng'anambukaje na kughaleka mahoku ghinu, maghambu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde uheghalile!”
Yesu abhaloha bhalohi ncheche

Yesu paakabhi ajenda mumaheku ja bahali ja Galilaya, akabhaweni bhalongu bhabheli bhalohe, Simoni joalowakeka Petulu na Andulea ndongu waki, bhakalobha homba mubahali kwa nkwabho, kwa ndandi bhakabhi bhalohe.
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Munyengalyaje, na nepani ananuntenda mwehapa kubha bhalohi bha bhandu.”
Palapala bhakajilekiki mikwabhu jabhu, na kunjengale Yesu.

Yesu paakajendali, palongi pachokopi akabhaweni bhalongu bhangi bhabheli, Yakobo na Yohana, bhana bhaka Zebedayo. Bhanihabha bhakabhi mkati mu ngalawa papamu na atati wabhu Zebedayo, bhakalenganakya mikwabhu jabhu. Yesu akabhalohike.
Palapala bhakajilekiki ngalawa papamu na atati wabhu, na kunjengale Yesu.
Yesu abhalamiha bhatamwa

Yesu akapiti kila pandu mu Galilaya, akabhabhola bhandu mu manyumba ya kuhimanganila Bhayahude, na kutangaza Malobhi Manyahi gha Ukolongwa waka Chapanga. Na kubhalamiha bhandu bhabhalwala hitamu ya kila ntundu na mabhinilu ghokapi.

Bhandu bhabhatama ku inchi jokapi ja ku Silia bhakajowini mambu ghanihagha. Bhakandeti bhandu bhamaheli bhabhang'ahika na hitamu ya kila ntundu na bhabhabhi na mabhinilu gha kila ntundu, bhabhabhi na majobhi, bhabhahinduka na bhabhatengwike, na Yesu akabhalamihe.
Mapogha ghamaheli gha bhandu kuhuma ku Galilaya, ku Dekapoli ndandi jaki michi komi, ku Yelusalemu, ku Yudea na kuhuma kwihi ja nkoka Yoludani, bhakunjengalile.
